subject: *: Support building FULLTEXT index (#60720)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs parent for DDL/add-index + metadata handling of FULLTEXT as a TiFlash columnar index. Confirmed the preprocessor rewrites FULLTEXT (CREATE INDEX + table constraints) into COLUMNAR with type FULLTEXT, executor routes to ActionAddColumnarIndex and worker uses the existing columnar-index state machine/backfill polling, and metadata updates (IndexInfo.FullTextInfo, IsColumnarIndex/GetColumnarIndexType, and prefix-length checks) consistently treat FULLTEXT as columnar. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in the touched DDL/meta paths.
